title: E2E visual oracle: color effects (tint/advanced CXForm) in published SWF
description: Add a Ruffle-based pixel-level acceptance test confirming tint and advanced color transform (CXFormWithAlpha) render correctly in a published SWF. The authoring canvas renderer handles these in renderer.ts lines 1078-1115 and compile.ts emits CXFormWithAlpha, but there is no e2e visual oracle verifying end-to-end fidelity through Ruffle.
